Where the institutions stood

Every documented standalone custodial institution in Canada, 1717 to 2025. Play the story, or take the controls yourself: drag the year, filter by status, click a province to zoom, or bring in census subdivision boundaries and the most recent homelessness counts.

Province

Markers sit at site coordinates where documented, otherwise at the city centre. Status colours are current (2026) status; the year slider filters by operating years. Census subdivision boundaries are Statistics Canada 2025 cartographic boundary files (lcsd000a25s_e), the same vintage used to assign each institution to its CSD, generalised for display.

Figure 1. Location of Canadian custodial institutions, 1717–2025, and their host census subdivisions. Institution data from Turner (2026a). Boundaries from Statistics Canada (2025). Population from Statistics Canada (2022). Homelessness counts, where shown, from Turner (2026b); regional totals are distributed across every census subdivision in the counted region and are labelled as regional.
